headline: Healthy outlook maintained!

highlights: Headquartered in India, with subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, and the UAE, Carysil’s reach extends to over 58 countries. • With the ramp up of its new capacities, Carysil has guided for a 15-20% topline growth in medium term.
Q2FY27 performance: Carysil reported 14.6% YoY growth in consolidated revenue to ₹275.7 crore in Q2FY27, driven by healthy volume growth across its key product categories.
Quartz sink and stainless-steel sink volumes grew 9.9% and 7.8% YoY to 217,000 units and 47,000 units, respectively, while faucet volumes increased 8% to 10,000 units.
Kitchen appliances volumes remained largely flat at 11,000 units.

Domestic revenue is targeted to reach ₹500 crore over the next 3–4 years, supported by improving profitability as input and freight costs normalise.
Rating and Target Price: We maintain BUY rating for Carysil with a revised price target of Rs.1250 valuing it at 25x its FY28E EPS.
